title: Waffle native folder record
description: Schema for one JSONL row of a Waffle native design. Validate the first row against header, then each recognized body row against the owning file's *Record schema. Use opaqueHeader/opaqueRecord only after applying the file's compatibility policy. Canonical bytes, encoding limits, identity, row order, required-feature support, file membership and digests require file-level validation.

id.description: Stable identifier. Existing opaque IDs survive reads and rewrites. Newly allocated native IDs use uuidV7.

uuidV7.description: Lowercase RFC 9562 UUID version 7 assigned to newly allocated native identities.

order.description: Fractional base-62 order key. Equal keys sort by record ID.

lengthNm.description: Signed integer nanometres. One millimetre is 1,000,000 nm.

pointNm.description: Point [x,y] in nanometres. X increases rightward, Y downward.

angleNdeg.description: Integer nanodegrees, positive counterclockwise unless a field says otherwise.

clockwiseAngle.description: Stored nanodegrees in [0,360 degrees). The codec negates the editor's clockwise rotation.

exactDecimal.description: Exact decimal string without exponent, redundant zeros, leading plus or negative zero.

nativeValue.description: Interpreted native value encoding. Nonintegral author numbers use {$number: exactDecimal}; $literal escapes reserved keys. Unknown optional fields can retain arbitrary JSON without interpretation.

portablePath.description: Root-relative slash-separated path. Filesystem portability, collision keys and allowed member locations are also checked by the reader.

queryBinding.description: Half-open UTF-16 offsets in source. Exact token spelling, order and occurrence identity are validated by the query reader.

anyOf.description: Later query language, preserved for viewing. This reader must not evaluate its predicate.

presetKey.description: Optional semantic slot of a fabrication preset or rule-set template. Record identity remains the id.

min.description: Rule-type-specific minimum in the rule's original unit.

max.description: Rule-type-specific author quantity in the rule's original unit, or null for an unset optional value. Nonintegral values use the native $number wrapper.

preferred.description: Rule-type-specific author quantity in the rule's original unit, or null for an unset optional value. Nonintegral values use the native $number wrapper.

packedSourceTable.description: Packed retained-source projection. Column arity is structural; dictionary indexes, decoded alignment and aggregate resource bounds are checked by the reader.

opaqueRecord.description: Opaque optional body row or body of an opaque owner, admitted by the file compatibility policy. Retain its exact physical JSON bytes and do not interpret additional fields.

opaqueHeader.description: First row of an opaque owner. Its required features and version determine whether the file can be represented safely.

allOf.description: Reserved codec kind. Retained source indexes are written as importBindings.

amendedOwnerHeader.description: Header produced for a schematic, PCB, drawing, panel or library by the amended 2.0 writer.

allOf.description: The owner file carries the same ID. For recognized document kinds, name is the path's filename stem. Unknown document kinds follow opaque-owner policy.

butterOptionalProjectHeader.description: Optional metadata manifest. Existing document and library owners keep their native version.

fragment.description: One-based page as a safe integer. The reader checks the bound and the referenced datasheet.

camera.description: Center is in integer nanometres. Nonintegral scales and radians use the native $number wrapper. The native reader checks decoded bounds.

asset.description: An embedded PDF. The native reader checks that the digest and length equal the outer reference.
